meta.title: Lake Erie Islands
meta.summary: Ooh, ferry day! Lively village streets, quieter beaches, or a long bicycle ride—the islands have different personalities. Let’s pick the one that feels like your kind of escape.

blocks.text: South Bass Island and Put-in-Bay bring the lively village mood. Kelleys Island pairs beaches and natural areas with a gentler pace, while Middle Bass and North Bass give you still more possibilities. And yes, the crossing counts as part of the adventure: lake air, a receding shoreline, and a pace that already feels like yours.

Choose the day you want before choosing the island: walking, cycling, history, nature, or a waterfront meal. Ferries, vehicle rules, routes, and activities vary by island and season, so check the operators directly. Shores & Islands Ohio is a good place to gather the pieces. No need to rush between islands; enjoy the one you’re on and let it set the pace for your day. I’d choose the island by the kind of day we want, then check the ferry. A quieter shore would be tempting with you along. ♡
